classes.name: Cinder Warden
classes.pitch: Stand in the pack and outlast it.
classes.blurb: A sentinel who brands steel with cinder. Slow to wake, hard to put down, and worse once the kiln-skills catch.

classes.name: Reed Caller
classes.pitch: Call glasslings, then shoot from behind them.
classes.blurb: A ranged binder who calls glasslings out of still water. Frail in a straight fight, dangerous once the chorus is up.

classes.name: Briar Stalker
classes.pitch: Lay the snares. Let the rot do the standing.
classes.blurb: A knife and a patient snare. You do not stand in the kiln, and you do not keep a chorus. You salt the ground and let the rot arrive.

classes.name: Salt Reaver
classes.pitch: Step through the pack and take a little life back.
classes.blurb: A fast blade that lives in arm's reach. You step through a pack, you cut on the way, and you take a little life back with you.

classes.name: Bell Chanter
classes.pitch: Ring the room, then sing the air thick.
classes.blurb: You ring shock into a room and sing the air thick. Not a chorus of glass. A bell, a hymn, and the people already beside you.

branches.name: Brand
branches.about: Close cuts that keep the cinder in the wound.

branches.name: Ember
branches.about: Sparks, wards, and the bloom that clears a pack.

branches.name: Warden
branches.about: Hide, leech, and Last Coal, which refuses a grave.

branches.name: Call
branches.about: Servants pulled out of glass and salt.

branches.name: Tide
branches.about: Cold bolts and the ring that clears a bank.

branches.name: Bond
branches.about: The knot that keeps you and the chorus alive, and Last Reed, which refuses a grave.

branches.name: Snare
branches.about: Thorns left in the path, and the jaw that closes them.

branches.name: Venom
branches.about: A needle, a cloud, and rot that refuses to finish.

branches.name: Hide
branches.about: Soft feet, a bitter coat, and Last Briar, which will not let you die.

branches.name: Edge
branches.about: Short cuts and the step that puts you through a pack.

branches.name: Tempo
branches.about: Speed, a spin, and the habit of being first.

branches.name: Vein
branches.about: What the cut takes back, and Last Salt, which keeps you up.

branches.name: Bell
branches.about: A note, a peal, and the shock that follows.

branches.name: Hymn
branches.about: Songs that slow a room and thicken your coat.

branches.name: Keep
branches.about: Breath, a quiet room, and Last Bell, which refuses a grave.
